messages:
harper: quick FYI 1: courier left a large bike box and a small flower crate in the lobby for our 2:45pm visitor (Lucas G.). He asked if we have a temporary lanyard; badge printer is out of visitor stickers. :bike: :package:
frontdesk: note from desk 1: badge printer out of 'visitor' rolls, only staff lanyards left. we can use a paper lanyard + safety pin as stopgap. box is on the left pallet near the plants.
rachel: can we reserve a hotdesk in row C? row B is full and Quiet Room 1 is booked. Lucas prefers a window seat if possible.
tomo: I can help move the bike box to Storage Bay B if it's heavy. tagging @frontdesk for locker/locker-code.
anita: please mark the flower crate fragile and add a sticky that says "Meet at 2:45". Also, can someone grab a tiny vase from kitchen so it doesn't get squashed? :seedling:
deliveries-bot: courier update: tracking #CBX-9923 delivered to reception at 14:05. ETA guest arrival 14:45. Signature: "Courier X".
frontdesk: temporary paper lanyard made and stapled. added handwritten "Lucas G.". Sticky note on bike box: FRAGILE.
harper: locker to hold bike box until evening? which one fits a 120cm box?
frontdesk: Storage Bay B shelf 4 fits 120cm. please use Locker-12 if you want it locked. code:
```
2846
```
We'll tape a note to shelf-4 saying "Lucas G. - hold until 18:00".
rachel: reservation update 1: moved row C seat 7 to window for Lucas. sending calendar invite to olivia to escort.
tomo: moved box to Storage Bay B shelf 4. left a note and locked Locker-12 with code. grabbing vase now.
anita: vase acquired 1: added plant padding and taped crate. looks good.
harper: huge thanks everyone! @tomo @frontdesk you're lifesavers. :heart: If the courier calls back, frontdesk please give code 2846 and confirm identity.
frontdesk: will do. marking thread resolved. (reaction: :white_check_mark:)
file_notes: watercooler: visitor luggage (bike box), temporary lanyard, locker storage, fragile crate, seating allocation
